title: [Auckland] Reimagining Technology Careers in the Age of AI
location: AUT Auckland CBD campus, WG Building, WG126, Auckland
description:
AI is changing how technology is built, how organisations operate, and what skills businesses value. Rather than focusing on AI technology itself, this event will explore a more personal question:
**What does the AI era mean for our careers in the IT industry?**

CITA and BA Career will bring together four senior technology and business leaders to share their perspectives on how careers, skills and leadership may evolve over the next 5–10 years.

Moving beyond the technology itself, our panel will explore how AI is reshaping the technology workforce, how professional roles and career pathways may evolve, and what individuals and organisations can do to prepare for the changes ahead.

Whether you're a software engineer, business analyst, product professional, QA specialist, data practitioner, technology leader, or someone aspiring to enter the IT industry, this conversation will offer valuable perspectives to help you navigate your next career move.

### **Panelist**

* [Francis Ho](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ACoAAAw8JG4B-JrgunVhXl6GTGvJYA9Bvz6RT7g/?utm_source=chatgpt.com), Director of Engineering at Auror
* [Sylvia Ding](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ACoAAACqP5sBgkv85jGQhxjG4L9l08CxqjrvFTM/?utm_source=chatgpt.com), Advisor and Coach at LumenCo
* [Abinesh Krishan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ACoAAACrBtUB_4Zd7UeaepF3SXbXCQgBNG1G8Lw/?utm_source=chatgpt.com), Chairperson of the Board at Potentia
* [Nathan Wallace](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ACoAAAUvOx4BncKVSOsFryu8WqrdRNtnQdxtYIA/?utm_source=chatgpt.com), Head of Digital Technology Operations at Millennium Hotels and Resorts

### **Facilitator**

[Kelly Hou](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kellyhou-nz/?utm_source=chatgpt.com), Head of Product Engineering at EverCommerce

title: Taking Generative AI from Prototype to Production on Azure / Best of Ignite
description:
An impressive AI demo can come together quickly. Turning it into a reliable enterprise application takes more than a good prompt.

In this session, Dhruv Ohri explores the engineering decisions behind moving generative AI from prototype to production on Azure.

Through practical examples and a demo, he will cover connecting AI to enterprise data and APIs, managing identity and access, validating outputs, and handling failures.

The session will also examine evaluation, monitoring, latency and cost, including where conventional application logic should take over from AI. Developers, architects and technology teams will leave with practical considerations for building AI applications that work beyond the demo.
\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-
**Dhruv Ohri** is the AI Practice Lead at Duco Consultancy, where he leads the architecture and delivery of AI-enabled applications and cloud solutions across Microsoft Azure and AWS.

His work spans generative AI, enterprise integrations, automation and production delivery, with a focus on turning prototypes into reliable, maintainable business applications
\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-

title: Welcome to the next AWS Auckland Well-Architected Meetup for 2026!
location: Level 13, Commercial Bay, 15 Customs Street West, Auckland CBD, Auckland 1010, Auckland
description:
Hi Architects,

Welcome to the next AWS Auckland Well Architected User Group Meetup of 2026!

At each meetup, we focus on learning and networking in a friendly and inclusive atmosphere and explore best-practices in AWS. This has resulted in the AWS Well-Architected Meetups becoming the most popular AWS Meetups in ANZ 🥳

**Please also note that AWS Security now requests a company name and company email where it is available. If you are a student, please list your institution and your student email address at that institution 👍**

We'll be announcing more speakers on [https://well-architected.me](https://well-architected.me/) and previewing presentations during the coming weeks - our speakers and details this month include:

* **Michael Taylor, Lakebase Specialist, Databricks**

**How Lakebase provides a well-architected platform for next generation application and AI development.**
Come and hear how Databricks experts show how customers run applications and agents on Lakebase; serverless Postgres governed by Unity Catalog. See instant branching, scale-to-zero, point-in-time recovery and synced tables in action. The Databricks team will also give a first look at LTAP; one open, governed copy of data for transactions and analytics, with no ETL in between.

* **Kristof Ringleff, Solution Architect, Fooman**

**From Weekend Project to Well-Architected: Putting AWS's new Well-Architected Agent to Work**

Kristoff had a small serverless weekend project running on AWS. So he pointed the brand-new AWS Well-Architected Agent at it. Then I did what any sensible engineer would do with a hobby app; I followed its advice. This talk covers what the agent found, what I learned along the way and the fun of over-engineering something that never needed it. I'll also compare it with the open-source Well-Architected Review skill, which runs in your own coding agent and needs no AWS Support plan.
